Amanda: Quick Q — where's the per-model GPU Util (SM%) + memory heatmap in Grafana? Trying to correlate a latency spike with batch_size change from yesterday. Anyone got links? :eyes:

Jorge: There's a dashboard under Infra > GPU Hosts -> "model_sm_mem_by_host". Grafana link: https://grafana.internal.redwood/g/d4gH2g/model-sm-and-mem
You can filter by model and time range.

Priya: Also check the KV cache hitrate panel on the same dashboard (top-right). If KV drops, we see extra memory churn.

Amanda: thanks — do we have a suggested alert for per-host mem P95? We saw one host hit 92% and OOM-killed a container.

Tom: We currently have an alert for host GPU memory > 88% for 5m. That's on PagerDuty. Maybe raise to 90% on non-prod but drop to 85% for prod.

Lina: fwiw the OOM you saw was due to batch_size bump (client-side config) not server-side scheduling. I'd add a slow ramp rule.

Jorge: Example promql for SM% panel:

```
avg by (model) (rate(nv_gpu_sm_busy_seconds_total[5m])) * 100
```

And for KV cache hitrate:

```
sum(hit_count) / sum(request_count)
```

Amanda: perfect. Can someone paste the dashboard panel IDs? I want to add a bookmarked link in the runbook.

Priya: Panel IDs: SM% = 78, Mem heatmap = 102, KV hitrate = 115

Amanda: awesome — also pinging @deploy-bot are there any autoscaling events around 2:20am UTC yesterday?

deploy-bot: Autoscaler: scaled up pool gpu_dedicated_1 by +2 at 2026-02-14T02:22:11Z — reason: queue_length > 0. Logs: https://logs.redwood/scalelog/abc123 :robot_face:

Tom: I'm going to tweak alert thresholds in the next change; will send a PR for review. @Amanda want me to include a canary period?

Amanda: yes please, 10m canary then promote. thanks :thumbsup:
